question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.**

He can't climb this tree, __can't he__?
solution:
The correct answer is: can he?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Replace "can't he" with "can he" to make the sentence correct.
 
• Question tags allow us to create a question out of a sentence by including an auxiliary verb and pronoun at the end of a statement.
 
• “Can you/he/she” is the appropriate question tag when a negative statement is made.
 
 
• Example - *“She can do this, can't she?” *
 
 
 
• “Can't you/he/she” is the appropriate question tag when a positive statement is made.
 
 
• Example - *“She cannot do this, can she?”*
 
 
 
• In the case of "Can't he/she?" you expect the answer to be "yes" and just ask for confirmation.
 
• In the case of "Can he/she?" you ask an "honest question" to acquire the information you want.
 
• In the given sentence the the statement clause is the negative sentence as it says **"He can't"**

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Corrected sentence: *He can't climb this tree,** ****can he__?***
